relation_to_existing: Separate from dependency-proposals.json, which was not edited and not checked for duplicates. Entries here cite only spans personally read for this receipt (1-364 and 410-901). Matching read receipts: read-receipts-pool-continuation.json.

proposals.owned_behavior: Pool workers authenticate only with a service account API key or a per-claim session token. Other key types are rejected.
Worker holds one outbound HTTPS connection to Cursor's cloud, and the agent loop stays in the cloud.
Requests match workers by repo=, pool=, worker= and machine= labels, with trigger options from Slack, GitHub, Linear and the API (usePrivateWorker, labels).
depends_on: Cloud Agents dashboard Allow/Require Self-Hosted toggles

proposals.owned_behavior: Pending requests are listed, streamed over SSE, claimed, released or failed through /v0/private-workers endpoints. The list is the source of truth and events are hints.
After a session ends the worker idles for a configured window to accept follow-ups, then exits 0. A restarted chat gets a fresh machine without workspace state.
A claimed offline machine can be revived with the same worker id inside workerReadyTimeoutSeconds, so a follow-up resumes with its workspace. Otherwise the claim is released or lapses.
depends_on: machine snapshot and restore provided by the operator
claimed_offline event or pending-request fields claimedWorkerId and wakeTimeoutMs

proposals.owned_behavior: agent worker controller starts workers through a --spawn hook in claim-then-spawn or warm-idle mode.
depends_on: anysphere/k8s-workers template (external GitHub repo, not read)

proposals.owned_behavior: --clone-git-repos checks out request repos on any-repo named pools, using a minted short-lived GitHub token, and removes its own clones on claim end.
depends_on: git on PATH (2.26+ for checkout reuse)

proposals.owned_behavior: --sync-dashboard-secrets delivers dashboard secrets and API envVars to a pool worker as environment variables during claimed runs.
Workers run command-based project and enterprise hooks, plus sessionStart and sessionEnd on claim and release. Those two events are skipped on Cursor-managed Cloud Agents.
FAQ says MCP servers work on self-hosted workers, are configured in the dashboard, and are routed by transport type. The routing table is at 387-396.
